en.page_desc: How Krino Matrix plans to get there (the Krino Tree, our interactive roadmap), and what exists today.
en.tree_lead: From what we ship today to our long-term vision, with honest status at every step.

seed.title: The Seed
seed.sub: AI companion platform, AI glasses & the Open Matrix
seed.blurb: Where we are today: a platform that remembers, the glasses that will be its first body, and an open interface so other hardware can become its body too.

embodiment.title: Embodiment
embodiment.sub: Context awareness, lifelong memory & persistent persona
embodiment.blurb: The companion moves into daily life: it notices context, keeps a lifetime of memory and stays the same person across devices.

neural.title: Neural Connection
neural.blurb: Every branch here starts at an external breakthrough we don't control. We build the software and the persona on top, never the implants.

ascension.title: Ascension
ascension.sub: Far-future forms of existence & continuity of consciousness
ascension.blurb: A research vision, not an engineering commitment. It depends on science that does not exist yet.

world_showcase.lead: A world that remembers you. Its AI characters have their own memories, voices and friends.
features: Keeps what matters and lets the small stuff fade, the way people do. If it gets something wrong, one click corrects it.
One sentence makes a character: an original, or one from a book, anime or game you love, written to canon.
Every character gets a voice designed from a description. They speak as they think, and you can cut in anytime.
Characters befriend each other, message, post moments and form their own impressions.
stats: to the first sound of streamed speech
to design a new voice from one sentence

seed.title: The Seed · 种子
seed.sub: AI 陪伴平台、AI 眼镜与开放矩阵
seed.blurb: 我们今天所在的位置：一个会记得的平台，将成为它第一个身体的眼镜，以及让别家硬件也能成为它身体的开放接口。

embodiment.title: Embodiment · 具身
embodiment.sub: 情境感知、长期记忆与持续人格
embodiment.blurb: 伴侣走进日常：能感知情境、记住一生，换了设备也还是同一个人。

neural.title: Neural Connection · 神经连接
neural.blurb: 这里每条枝干都从一个我们无法掌控的外部突破开始。我们只做其上的软件与人格，从不做植入物。

ascension.title: Ascension · 飞升
ascension.sub: 远期存在形态与意识连续性探索
ascension.blurb: 这是研究愿景，不是工程承诺。它依赖今天还不存在的科学。

world_showcase.lead: 一个会记得你的世界。这里的 AI 角色有自己的记忆、声音和朋友。
features: 重要的事一直记得，琐碎的会慢慢淡忘——像人一样。记错了，你点一下就能纠正。
一句话写出一个角色：原创的，或者你喜欢的书、动漫、游戏里的——会先去查原作设定。
每个角色都有按描述设计出来的专属声音，边想边说，你也可以随时打断。
角色之间也会加好友、私聊、发动态，对彼此有自己的印象。
stats: 流式语音的第一个声音
按一句描述设计一个新声音
